name: MISB ST 0601 full-motion video
description: Full-motion video with MISB ST 0601 UAS Datalink Local Set metadata, for a video layer draped on the globe. remux demultiplexes an MPEG-2 transport stream (PAT/PMT, H.264 and KLV PES, 33-bit PTS unwrapped across rollover), remuxes the H.264 video to fragmented MP4 for Media Source Extensions and writes a per-frame footprint table; footprints writes one SDS $GDI per ST 0601 packet. Packets are checksum-checked (tag 1) and error values are treated as absent. A footprint comes from the stated corner points (tags 82-89), else the frame centre and corner offsets (23/24 and 26-33), else the sensor corner rays from the platform and sensor pose (5-7 or 90/91, 13-20, 75 or 15) intersected with WGS84 at the frame-centre elevation (25).

sequentialJustification.detail: Deterministic parsing of one transport stream per call: demultiplexing, box writing and closed-form footprint geometry. No host calls, threads or network access.

inputPorts.description: Size-prefixed SDS $NCD describing the transport stream (FORMAT UNSPECIFIED or PROVIDER_DEFINED); SOURCE_BYTE_LENGTH and SOURCE_SHA256 are checked against the bytes on port "stream" when stated.

acceptedTypeSets.description: SDS $NCD container descriptor of the stream.

inputPorts.description: The MPEG-2 transport stream's exact bytes (188-byte packets, or 192-byte M2TS packets), H.264 video with MISB ST 0601 KLV.

wildcardJustification.detail: The MPEG-2 transport stream's exact bytes (188-byte packets, or 192-byte M2TS packets), H.264 video with MISB ST 0601 KLV.

outputPorts.description: The fragmented MP4 initialization segment: ftyp and moov with one avc1 track (avcC from the stream's first SPS and PPS) and mvex; timescale 90000.

wildcardJustification.detail: The fragmented MP4 initialization segment: ftyp and moov with one avc1 track (avcC from the stream's first SPS and PPS) and mvex; timescale 90000.

outputPorts.description: Fragmented MP4 media segments (moof and mdat), each starting at a sync sample, in decode order; at most 60.

wildcardJustification.detail: Fragmented MP4 media segments (moof and mdat), each starting at a sync sample, in decode order; at most 60.

outputPorts.description: The per-frame footprint table, little-endian float64: header [1, rows, epochMs, 90000] then per frame in presentation order [key, valid, LL lon, LL lat, LR lon, LR lat, UR lon, UR lat, UL lon, UL lat]; key is the presentation time in 90 kHz ticks.

wildcardJustification.detail: The per-frame footprint table, little-endian float64: header [1, rows, epochMs, 90000] then per frame in presentation order [key, valid, LL lon, LL lat, LR lon, LR lat, UR lon, UR lat, UL lon, UL lat]; key is the presentation time in 90 kHz ticks. A control frame between the caller and this module, never persisted.
